thread:
rafa: Hey team just started today super excited! Quick map request: who do I page for (A) model runtime failures vs (B) infra/node problems vs (C) rollout/config issues? Also who approves dev-gpu access and PagerDuty? Any tiny runbook or checklist for a new hire getting on-call-ready?

nate: welcome Rafa! :tada: Short mapping: (A) eng-runtime on-call, (B) eng-sre on-call, (C) eng-platform on-call. People-ops handles PagerDuty additions (after shadowing), infra grants dev-gpu access.

celine: extra nuance: if the issue is model-quality (bad outputs, hallucinations) that's an "evals"/product issue you loop in ML-evals + eng-platform. If it's resource related (OOM, GPU ECC errors) -> eng-sre. If process crashes or mem leaks -> eng-runtime. For cross-cutting issues page both and tag a platform lead.

rafa: sweet. who actually approves the IAM request and how long does it take?

maya: flow is manager -> people-ops triage -> infra grants role. Use https://redwood.internal/access-request select "dev-gpu" and attach a manager approval screenshot if needed. Typical turnaround 1-2 business days; for urgent access ping @people-ops in Slack after filing.

people-ops: Confirmed. PagerDuty: we require 1 week shadowing + manager sign-off before adding to rotations. To get started with shadowing, ping a team lead to be your mentor. We also require completion of the new-hire oncall checklist. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/new-hire-checklist.md

nate: here's a tiny in-channel cheat I use when pairing new folks (pasteable):
```
Escalation TL;DR
1) detect -> post to #incidents + tag eng-runtime OR eng-sre
2) 0-5m: primary on-call ack expected
3) 5-15m: escalate to secondary & add incident channel
4) 15m+: call incident commander and exec on-call
Security incidents: page eng-security immediately and DO NOT paste payloads.
```

celine: runbooks you should read first: /runbooks/inference/first-responders, /runbooks/platform/rollouts, and the ownership matrix in the handbook: https://redwood.internal/handbook/ownership-matrix. If you don't have repo access yet, attach the access-request link and @people-ops will fast-track it after manager approval.

rafa: great. who owns post-incident follow-up and blameless blamestorms?

nate: eng-sre usually owns postmortem infra items, eng-runtime owns runtime fixes, eng-platform owns rollout/process changes, and product/ML-evals own quality regressions. The incident commander assigns owners during the post-incident triage. We keep a short template in the runbooks.

oncall-bot: Note: eng-sre rota changes 2026-09-01. Check on-call calendar: https://redwood.internal/oncall-calendar

rafa: last Q: any shortcuts for urgent rollback or hotfixes?

celine: prefix your Slack message with "rollback" to trigger the rollout bot checklist if it's a deployment rollback. For hotfixes, page eng-platform AND eng-runtime, and use the rollback checklist link in the runbook. If in doubt, say "shadowing new hire" and someone on-call will guide you through the steps.

rafa: thanks all — filling the access form and will DM my manager about a mentor. Appreciate the quick map! :raised_hands:
